description: Ten-row opening-balance create with hours, entitlement, carryover and remaining days for staff matched by name. Measured by TestOpeningBalanceImportBatchQueryBudget after two warmups (ADR 0067 addendum 2026-11-08, Messplan N10/N110). The batch path writes each row without a row savepoint, because a failed row aborts its whole chunk (#5552, ADR 0067 addendum step 3).
